note: Sample listings for the hackathon demo. Application links point at example.com so the app never sends a student to a guessed employer page.

opportunities.title: Software Engineering Intern
requirements: Enrolled on an undergraduate degree
Coursework or a project using JavaScript or Python
Able to spend 12 weeks in Manchester
opportunities.summary: Build small features on a student-facing web product with a mentor on the team.

opportunities.title: Data Analyst Placement
requirements: A placement year or a degree that allows a year in industry
Comfortable with spreadsheets and one of Python or SQL
opportunities.summary: A year-long placement turning operational data into weekly briefing notes.

opportunities.title: City Data Hackathon
requirements: Open to any current student
Teams of two to four form on the day
Bring a laptop
opportunities.summary: A weekend hackathon using open city datasets. Beginners are welcome on mixed teams.

opportunities.title: Product Design Intern
requirements: A portfolio of three interface or poster projects
Remote within the UK
opportunities.summary: Design internship for students who want to practise interface work with a real critique cycle.

opportunities.title: Junior Software Engineer
requirements: Graduating this academic year or already graduated
A project you can demo that uses JavaScript
opportunities.summary: Entry-level engineering role on the energy-usage dashboard team.

opportunities.title: Business Analyst Placement
requirements: Placement year student
Clear writing samples
Right to work a placement in the UK
opportunities.summary: Help clinical teams describe the data they need. No prior health-service job is required.

opportunities.title: Open Source Student Sprint
requirements: Any current student
Git installed before the opening session
opportunities.summary: A remote weekend contributing a small pull request to a student-maintained project.

opportunities.title: Marketing Intern
requirements: Two writing samples
Available in London for eight weeks
opportunities.summary: Closed sample listing, kept so the app can show a passed deadline instead of hiding it.

opportunities.title: Mechanical Engineering Intern
requirements: Studying mechanical, mechatronic, or a closely related degree
A CAD coursework sample
opportunities.summary: Summer internship prototyping a small robot arm with the hardware team.

opportunities.title: Graduate Software Engineer
requirements: Graduating this year
Able to explain a database project in an interview
opportunities.summary: First job on a payments ledger. The team pairs every new graduate with a mentor.

opportunities.title: Audio Production Placement
requirements: Placement-year student
A short recording you can share
opportunities.summary: Produce interview segments for a student news show based in Manchester.

opportunities.title: Cybersecurity Intern
requirements: Undergraduate in computing or a related subject
Interest in defensive security, not attack instructions
Able to join the Edinburgh office for ten weeks
opportunities.summary: Defensive security internship: log review, documentation, and supervised lab exercises.
